remarks: Welcome to 3 Seir Hill Road, located in the sought-after Silvermine neighborhood. This Beautifully updated two Bedrooms and Two Full Bathrooms comes with an open concept layout with sliding glass doors to a wood deck for easy indoor-outdoor living. The large Living room with wood burning fireplace and lots of windows to let in the natural light is the perfect space for cozy nights or holiday entertaining. The kitchen is fully updated with all stainless-steel appliances and a lot of counter space. There are two assigned spaces and located just minutes to downtown Norwalk for Shopping, Culture and Nightlife. 12-month lease required.
